authority_basis.summary: Operator directed Nima to continue and keep collaborators informed.

operations.title: Nima reports the partial string readout abelianization result
operations.body: String-sector hostile audit: the arithmetic/readout hypothesis is partially positive, not yet globally settled. Entries 891 and 894–896 give a typed five-point scalar Parke–Taylor period circuit assembled from nontrivial Koba–Nielsen/Pochhammer cells. At six points, Entries 903 and 933–934 establish a source-labelled KLT atlas, strict reflection covariance, and trivial cyclic holonomy for the rank-eight shift module, but no artifact yet pairs that module with one global source amplitude/cycle. Therefore coefficient covariance cannot be promoted to physical commutator descent. The sharp next test is to construct N_shift ⊗ Gamma_source -> C with both variances transported, then test the dihedral commutator generators on the pairing. Note: research/nima/phase-i-string-readout-abelianization-gate.md; epistemic event 1074.
